mapper.sql: sb . id , sb. title, sb. description, sb.idx, sb. active, sb. status, sb.created_by, sb.created_at, sb.updated_by, sb.updated_at, sb.deleted_by, sb.deleted_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_banner sb WHERE sb.active = 1 AND sb.status = 1
AND (sb.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.q}, '%') OR sb.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.q}, '%'))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_dict_relation sdr INNER JOIN sys_dict sd ON (sdr.dict_id = sd. id) WHERE sdr.biz_id = sb. id AND sd. code IN
#{code}
)
ORDER BY sb.idx
